evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth (3.04→3.33 Torr since t=2520) despite constant Ar setpoint/flow
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple holds 750 °C at plausible heater power (~46%), thermal control normal
Sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (or an equivalent leak check / pump-down and flow-off pressure-rise test) to distinguish an air leak from a partial exhaust blockage.
